summary: Feature testing for Flusso v4 - All 19 backend tests passed, all frontend UI tests passed. Features verified: 1) Fornitori year selector, 2) Fornitori modal with month selector showing individual purchase rows, 3) Statistiche period-specific KPIs, 4) Charts (BarChart for single month, AreaChart for multiple), 5) Prezzi Mercati with city names.

issues: Console warnings about HTML nesting (span inside tr, select inside span) - Framer Motion wrappers issue, does not affect functionality
Console warnings about chart width/height -1 during initial render - charts still render correctly after load

critical_code_review_comments: All requested features are working correctly
Frontend uses browser's native date picker - acceptable for MVP
context_for_next_testing_agent: All v4 features verified working: year selector in Fornitori, month selector modal with individual acquisti rows, period-specific Statistiche KPIs, BarChart for single months, Prezzi Mercati widget.

Feature1_FornitoriYearSelector.evidence: GET /api/fornitori-with-stats returns {fornitori, anni_disponibili}. Years 2026/2025/2024 available. Changing year updates fatturato values correctly.

Feature2_FornitoriMonthModal.evidence: GET /api/fornitori/{nome}/prodotti returns 'acquisti' array with individual rows (prodotto, data, quantita, prezzo_unitario, totale). Month selector shows Italian labels (Ottobre 2025, Marzo 2025, etc.). Changing month reloads data correctly.

Feature3_StatistichePeriodKPIs.evidence: KPI cards show 'Fatturato Periodo', 'Articoli Venduti', 'Clienti Attivi' for vendite view. Acquisti view shows 'Speso Periodo', 'Articoli Acquistati', 'Fornitori Attivi'. No more cumulative 'Fatturato Mese'.

Feature4_MesePrecedenteFilter.evidence: Clicking 'Mese Precedente' applies date filter 01/01/2026-01/31/2026 and updates ALL KPIs and charts with period-specific data.

Feature5_ChartRendering.evidence: Single month data renders as BarChart. Multiple months render as AreaChart. Pie chart tooltip shows client/supplier name and amount on hover.

Feature6_PrezziMercati.evidence: GET /api/prezzi-mercati returns 8 Italian cities (Bologna, Bolzano, Cesena, Lusia, Milano, Roma, Torino, Verona) with valid Azure blob storage URLs. Widget displays clickable links.
